name: Identity
what design modules must represent: One identity per component across trials and versions, including below the SoA row (tests in panels)

name: Layer relations
what design modules must represent: Explicit relations between layers: inherits, delegates, overridable default, restates, extends, overrides

name: Obligations
what design modules must represent: Delegations and defaults as checkable obligations: an unanswered delegation or a silent default is detectable, not found later

name: Unstated sharing
what design modules must represent: Shared content that no document states as shared

name: Version binding
what design modules must represent: Binding to the version of the layer depended on; the effect of a parent amendment on each child

name: Event anchors
what design modules must represent: Events inside a visit as anchors ("post randomization" inside Visit 3)

name: Decisions
what design modules must represent: Decisions with rationale and alternatives, the part public sources barely give

name: Documents as views
what design modules must represent: The document set, layer boundaries and numbering, which documents carry badly today
